Parse the sheets of a Plankton Toolbox export

Source: R/microscopy.R
parse_ptbx_sample.Rd

Parse the sheets of a Plankton Toolbox export

Usage

parse_ptbx_sample(info, data, method, file_name)

Arguments

info

The sample_info.txt sheet (key/value).

data

The sample_data.txt sheet.

method

The counting_method.txt sheet.

file_name

Name of the source file.

Value

A data.frame with one row per taxon, sorted by abundance class (highest first), with columns sample_file, station_reported, sample_date, latitude, longitude, min_depth_m, max_depth_m, sampler, counting_method, analysed_by, name, display_name, taxon_class, trophic_type, abundance_class and abundance_label.
